title: Workspace registry with single write owner
action: Registry at controlRoot: workspaces/<id>.json {id, type: main|worktree, root, branch, base_sha, write_owner_session, created_at}. Main checkout auto-registered. One write owner per workspace: claiming write ownership is O_EXCL/fenced (reuse lease/fence patterns); a second session attaching to the same workspace gets read-only attach (recorded). Worktree create/merge flows register/unregister. Sessions carry workspace_id (fills the lease/workflow records' workspace_id field, until now null). Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/ (vendored to .bee/bin/ + plugin mirrors).

truths: two sessions on one workspace: exactly one write owner, second attaches read-only (test)
prohibitions: no unregistered workspace gains write ownership

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Workspace registry (workspace-store.mjs): controlRoot/.bee/runtime/workspaces/<id>.json {id,type,root,branch,base_sha,write_owner_session,fence_epoch,attached_sessions,created_at}; idempotent registerWorkspace/unregisterWorkspace; O_EXCL-lock-fenced claimWriteOwnership (strict, throws WORKSPACE_OWNED naming holder) + attachWorkspace (forgiving, records read-only attach); heartbeat-staleness reclaim via caller-supplied isOwnerLive predicate (structural isolation from claims.mjs preserved). Wired into worktree-store.mjs: createFeatureWorktree registers (+rollback on failure), performCleanup unregisters (mirrors grant removal). claims.mjs: createSession + claimCellFile now stamp/carry workspace_id (auto-looked-up from the acting session's own record). hooks/bee-session-init.mjs re-rooted onto resolveContext.controlRoot for session creation (closing the gap adapter.mjs's msn-18c comment flagged as deferred), stamps workspace_id, and lazily auto-registers the workspace on first touch. Condition-4 compose test proves grant (store topology) and ownership (session concurrency) are independent, composable axes across all 4 combinations.
